name: notify
description: Post an organization's events to Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams or an HMAC-signed webhook: a release cut, a deploy that succeeded or failed (any executor, Jenkins and GitHub Actions included), readiness blocking a release, CI failing on a release tag; filters per event kind and project, deliveries visible to admins
author: actionplatform
needs: net: the webhook URLs the organization sets (hooks.slack.com, discord.com, the Teams workflow's host, its own endpoint); public addresses only
env: APX_NOTIFY_ALLOW_PRIVATE=1 on the worker lets a webhook reach a private or loopback address (self-hosted platforms)
